---
title: "Extract Variance Components"
---

## Extract Variance Components {.unnumbered}


### Description

Extracts variance component estimates from a fitted <code>masreml</code>
object into a tidy data.frame, showing heritability and proportion
of total variance explained by each component.



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>varcomp(x)
</code></pre>


### Arguments

<table>
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="x">x</code></td>
<td>
object of class <code>"masreml"</code> from <code>masreml()</code> or
<code>gwablup()</code>.
</td></tr>
</table>


### Value

data.frame with columns:


<ul>
<li> <code>Component</code>: name of variance component
(e.g. <code>snp_add</code>, <code>mh_add</code>, <code>residual</code>)

</li>
<li> <code>Sigma2</code>: estimated variance component

</li>
<li> <code>H2</code>: heritability (<code>sigma2 / sigma2_total</code>);
<code>NA</code> for residual component

</li>
<li> <code>Proportion</code>: proportion of total phenotypic variance

</li></ul>



### See Also

<code>masreml</code>, <code>summary.masreml</code>



### Examples
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
library("masreml")

d   <- load_data("small")
y   <- d$pheno$y_cont_qtl_snp; names(y) <- d$pheno$id
fit <- masreml(y, markers = list(snp_add = d$snp))
varcomp(fit)




```
